technology_name: Dual-Layered Janus Membrane for Water Recovery
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard membrane distillation schemes fail when treating highly saline water because oily organic foulants wet the pore channels, causing irreversible salt crystallization and performance collapse.
description: An asymmetric dual-layered Janus membrane fabricated by creating a hydrophilic polydopamine (PDA) functionalized layer on a robust MIL-53(Al) metal-organic framework, combined with a non-solvent induced phase separated hydrophobic PVDF support.
applications: Membrane distillation, industrial hypersaline brine crystallization treatment, oil-water emulsion splitting, and zero-liquid-discharge (ZLD) purification loops.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
